about_the_game:
Step into an action packed dinosaur arena brawler where you engage life or death fights that will push your abilities to their limits. King of Bones delivers physics-driven skill-based combat that carries the full weight and impact of prehistoric creatures. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through a diverse range or deadly dinosaurs as you battle to become king of the Jurassic world.

PHYSICS DRIVEN COMBAT

Vicious raptors will pounce and cling to your body. A charging triceratops can send you flying. Every part of the fighting system was crafted to bring the experience of clashing dinosaur to life. The prehistoric world was a dangerous one and you will fear the other dinosaurs that enter the arena, as they will learn to fear you.

REALTIME PHYSICALLY SIMULATED BODIES

Using the latest Unreal Engine tools the dinosaurs' physical bodies are simulated in the world which means every rock, tree, and body interact properly with each other.

INCREDIBLE ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Subtle breathing of your dinosaur, dynamic stances, real-time body controls, detailed animations and so much more breathe stunning life into the dinosaurs. Leaves move beneath your feet and blow to the wind with a mighty roar. The small details are what makes this an experience like no other.

WEAPONS AND ENVIRONMENTAL DANGERS

Grab a nearby log or bone to wield against your foe. Get blasted through the air by a high powered geyser hidden beneath the foggy waters. Or use your last kill's tail to bash your next kill. King of Bones will let you engage in all sorts of crazy carnage you've only ever imagined.

EXOTIC SPECIES

With over 30 unique species, the arena will challenge you in different ways as each species has their own fighting style. Get crushed by an Ankylosaur's tail swings. Send dinosaurs flying with the Pachycephalosaurus headbutt. Every dinosaur is dangerous in its own way.

GORE AND DISMEMBERMENT

Rip the flesh of your prey to shreds and consume every last bit of them. Fully dismemberable and simulated bodies mean you can make the most of your meal. The scars and wounds of battle and each bite taken out of you will all be readily visible.

King of Bones is a bold attempt at pushing forward the combat mechanics in the dinosaur simulation genre. Don't expect the typical RPG experience, expect non-stop straight up fights for your life. In the prehistoric world... death finds a way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 980 or equivalent with 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1080 or equivalent with 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: King of Bones is a fast-paced dinosaur fighting game with physics-driven skill-based combat. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through a diverse range of deadly foes as you engage in a life or death battle to dominate the arena.
